text: Trip TR-4390 to the Brannock Highlands ended; the traveller found the Brannock Lodge cold and the breakfast too far away.
Trip TR-4471 was confirmed after the deposit was paid; ferries chosen for 14 and 19 November.
Trip TR-4520 to Mirelake was confirmed at the Mirelake Quay Hotel.
The Carrow Ferry Company published its winter timetable with the 23:30 overnight sailing from Mirelake.
Trip TR-4588 for a family of four was held at the Carrow Harbour Inn while the family chooses a crossing.
Trip TR-4602 to Port Ellery was confirmed at the Ellery Sands Guesthouse with a sea-view room requested.
A traveller asked whether bicycles can go on the Carrow ferry; the desk sent the luggage policy.
The Port Ellery to Carrow route moved to its winter days, Friday to Monday only.
